title: The flat plan versus usage
hook: Two stated cases: explore the usage threshold in a plan comparison.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the usage threshold in a plan comparison affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Extra, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the usage threshold in a plan comparison in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
